investigation_result: Net sales matches completed sales minus cancelled amount
evidence: Completed sales 10,666,684.54 minus cancelled amount 896,812.49 equals recalculated net sales 9,769,872.05.
recommended_action: Clarify completed sales, cancelled amount, and net sales KPI definitions.
business_impact: May cause confusion during sales performance review if KPI definitions are not clearly documented.

investigation_result: Customer-level reporting is affected by missing CustomerID values.
evidence: 135,080 transaction rows have missing CustomerID values, representing 24.93% of transaction rows.
recommended_action: Separate known and missing customer ID rows in customer-level reports.
business_impact: Customer-level analysis may be incomplete unless missing-customer rows are reported separately.

investigation_result: Duplicate-flagged rows exist and should be monitored.
evidence: 10,147 duplicate-flagged rows were found, with 47,388.66 in completed sales amount.
recommended_action: Keep duplicate row monitoring visible in data quality reports.
business_impact: Duplicate rows may inflate transaction counts and should be monitored in data quality reporting.
